name: Jordan The River
overview: The Jordan River holds profound significance in Scripture as the site where God demonstrated His power by enabling Israel to cross into the Promised Land, as recorded in Joshua 3. Joshua instructed the people to follow the ark of the covenant closely yet maintain a respectful distance, sanctifying themselves in anticipation of the Lord's wondrous work. This event marks a pivotal moment of divine intervention and covenant fulfillment, underscoring God's faithful guidance and provision for His people.
